newsitem.title: USA: Legg Mason's board OKs 4-for-3 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Legg Mason's board OKs 4-for-3 stock split.

text.p: Legg Mason Inc said Thursday its board approved a four-for-three split of its common stock, payable September 24 to shareholders of record on September 8 1997.
Legg Mason's board also approved a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.11 per share on a post-split basis, which it will pay October 27 to shareholders of record on October 9.
The company said the stock split and regular dividend effectively increased its cash dividend by 12.8 percent.
Legg Mason's stock hit a new 52-week high of 58-7/8 Thursday morning. The shares traded at 58-1/2 later, up 1-1/4.
